title: Data Classes

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Data Classes** as part of **Classes, Objects, and Object-Oriented Fundamentals**. A data class generates value-oriented methods from primary-constructor properties; `copy()` is shallow and shared referenced objects remain shared. Use the subtopics—Generated Properties and Methods, copy() and Destructuring, Equality and Data Modeling—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.

content_blocks.title: Common mistake to avoid
content_blocks.text: A data class copy recursively duplicates every object referenced by its properties.
